review_comments: I think we should remove this property as it is now replaced by `self._attr_hvac_action`
Just realized this integration only supports cool mode and was using HVAC mode instead of action to represent the current state, so it should be OK to fix it to `HVACMode.COOL`
Yeah, it's all a bit messy. It actually seems to be able to do both cooling and heating according to the potential actions, but setting it to HEAT_COOL allows setting a range.
